# Pesticide Giant Syngenta Appoints New CEO
## CEO and Illinois farmer Jeff Rowe will be succeeded by Hengde Qin, the operating chief and former head of its China business
![Syngenta CEO Jeff Rowe at his family farm in Princeton, Illinois.](https://images.wsj.net/im-965448?width=700&height=466)Syngenta CEO Jeff Rowe will remain in the role through Aug. 1 before returning to the U.S.Anthony Collins/Syngenta

Syngenta said Hengde Qin, the company’s chief operating officer and head of its seeds business, will take over as CEO.
